results.rationale: The central lantern retains its contour, gold panel motifs and tassel. Golden willow leaves, petals and warm sparkling gradient are added, but the headline sits over the lantern rather than at the top and the bottom slogan is reduced to in Lights beneath the headline. The final poster is visually coherent with readable gold lettering and clean decorative forms.

The glass plate and white background remain, but all apples change shape, color pattern and orientation. Six apples still occupy the plate instead of one, so the count instruction fails. The edited fruits are individually coherent with natural stems, smooth skin and plausible highlights.
